proc ensurePkgSource(cfg: DatpkgrConfig) {.
    ...raises: [Exception, StorageError, KeyError],
    tags: [ReadIOEffect, WriteIOEffect, RootEffect], forbids: [].}

Make sure the carne registry source is registered. Fresh homes get it from datpkgr's own defaults; homes created before the registry existed carry a sourceless sources.json that ensureSourcesFile never upgrades (it only writes when missing), so add it here.

NB: consult the raw file, not loadSources - its fallback fabricates a usable-looking entry named defaultSourceName when the file yields nothing, which is indistinguishable from a registered source.

    ReadEnvEffect, ReadIOEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteDirEffect, WriteIOEffect,
    RootEffect], forbids: [].}
datpkgr config rooted at the carne home, wired to package.json manifests, the carne packages registry and plain CLI logging. rootPath overrides the home (tests point it at a temp dir for hermetic runs). ensureSource = false skips the home-dir IO.

proc resolvePkgImport(cfg: DatpkgrConfig; spec: string; preferRef = ""): Option[
    string] {....raises: [Exception, KeyError, InvalidVersionError, ValueError,
                       OSError], tags: [ReadDirEffect, RootEffect,
                                        WriteIOEffect, WriteDirEffect,
                                        ReadIOEffect, TimeEffect], forbids: [].}
Map pkg/<name> (or pkg/<name>/sub/path) to an absolute script path, none when unresolvable. Develop checkouts win automatically via resolveInstalledPath. .. escapes are rejected. preferRef pins an exact installed version/ref instead of the default pick.
